interest_tiers.fresh: 15 slots. FIFO by last_seen. count irrelevant for eviction. Promoted when count >= 2.
interest_tiers.mentioned: 10 slots. Decay 15 days → fresh, count=0. Promoted to confirmed via swap.
interest_tiers.confirmed: 10 slots. Static unless swap. Only entry: swap with strongest mentioned. Exit: swap → fresh, count=0.
interest_tiers.swap_logic: strongest mentioned vs weakest confirmed by (count, last_seen DESC). Loser → fresh, count=0.
interest_tiers.llm_role: LLM names confirmed_interests (active in dialog) and mentioned_interests (vague). Code does all transitions.

key_architecture_knowledge.media_tiers: Identical logic to interests. 15/10/10. type field preserved.
key_architecture_knowledge.achievements_system: achievements_count (counter, never resets) + sphere_history (monthly aggregates in deep_profile, 12-month rolling). achievements[] array is dead legacy — existing users keep it, new users do not get it.
key_architecture_knowledge.web_search_flow: Classifier → web_search intent → parallel _tavily_search_raw (supports queries[]) → data block appended to SR messages[0] → SR responds with full context. _synthesize_search is dead code.
key_architecture_knowledge.synthesis_trigger: Reactive: every 2 sr_observations via _add_sr_observation. Also forced at 21:00 in _send_daily_report for active gardeners.
key_architecture_knowledge.ram_github: All data loaded to RAM on startup (_store). GitHub sync every 2 minutes. GitHub is archive, RAM is working storage.
